name: Corrupt Primal of Water

facts.text: The four Corrupt Primals rise at the waterfall bridge after the voices; Olcasgean wakes only when all four are dead. Their shared line is 'We shall protect.'
Level 83, 125,000 health. Below 30% it walks to its pool once, cannot be hurt while it retreats, heals a sixth of its health and comes back.
It sends a target to one of two fixed spots by the falls.

story:
The rivers of Hy Brasil run toward the hollow now, and the water that reaches it stays. The Primal of Water is what the Root made of it: a guardian that remembers it was a spring. Hurt it badly and it does what water does when it is wounded. It goes home. It slides back into its pool, where nothing can reach it, and drinks, and comes back a sixth of itself the stronger. It does this once. The Sylvan say a spring can only forgive itself so many times. It also has a current's habit of carrying people where they did not mean to go.

Every spring of Hy Brasil once ran to the sea. Now the rivers bend toward the hollow, and the water that reaches it stays. The Root made a guardian of it, and the guardian remembers it was a spring: it fights like a flood, it carries people where they did not mean to go, two places by the falls where the current always drops them, and when it is badly hurt it does what water does.

It goes home. It slides back to its pool at the foot of the bridge, and while it is going nothing can hurt it, any more than a sword can hurt a river. In the pool it drinks, and comes back a sixth of itself the stronger, and fights again. It does this once. The Sylvan say a spring can forgive itself only so many times. When it dies the waters of the hollow run clear for a moment, and the Conservator's pool, far off in the galleries, dims, as if something had been taken from its hoard.
legend: Burn it to thirty, then stop: it runs to its pool and nothing hurts it there. Wait at the edge, let it heal, and kill it when it comes back. It only does it once. Watch for being swept to the far side of the falls. The trap is mana. A raid that keeps casting while it walks to the pool spends everything on nothing, and has nothing left when it comes back. Call the pause loudly, hold, and burst it on its return. The old hands' word for it is simple: patience. Water forgives itself once; a raid gets no second chance if it wastes its mana.

aggro: The water remembers. The water returns.
The spring remembers the sea. It does not want to go.
Water rises over the bridge stones: we shall protect.

loremasterTopic.text: The springs of the isle, turned to his use. Wounded, it slips back into its pool where nothing can follow, heals, and returns, but only once.

bookPage: A Sylvan water-song, as Aodhan heard it in Domnann: Spring, little spring, run to the sea; the sea is your mother, she waits for thee. They sang it to me with long faces and explained that the springs no longer run to the sea but down, into the hollow, and that the guardian at the bridge is all of them together, turned. I asked how the raiders kill it. A Sylvan warden said: you wound it, and it goes home to the pool to forgive itself, and you wait at the edge with your sword down, and when it comes back you finish it. You must be patient with water, he said. That is the whole of the song.
